summary: Valorant entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Valorant

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: VALORANT is a 5v5 tactical shooter on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5, with PC specs up to 144+ FPS. Windows PC is the best fidelity/competitive capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Install the current Riot PC client, meet or exceed the 144+ FPS spec target for capture, and record patch/episode/act because maps, agents, balance, and anti-cheat requirements change.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC route with Riot's high-end 144+ FPS spec target and primary competitive ecosystem.
all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity, input, and capture route for the tactical shooter.

all_releases.fidelity: Official console route with cross-progression/cross-inventory support.
all_releases.reason: skip: valuable console route but no sourced exclusive story/mode content over PC; keep separate if studying controller-tuned balance.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive story/mission content is sourced; PC is the fidelity/input primary and consoles are alternate competitive ecosystems.

entries.remaster_caveats: VALORANT is live-service and Vanguard-protected; patch state, anti-cheat requirements, maps, agents, and balance should be dated in archive captures.
